meta.name: Parallax Plates
meta.notes: Primary drives a duotone rhythm (deep sections at 28% primary in black, pale at 10% primary in white), tinted card plates, the hero backing plate, add buttons and the CTA plate; accent is only used for focus rings.

issues: Scroll reveal only relied on IntersectionObserver per element: the whole 'Shop by category' section, story/gallery/quote/CTA and 4 of 6 mobile product cards stayed at opacity 0 (huge empty deep/pale blocks, catalog CTA missing)
'Added to your cart' toast sat permanently visible just under the fold (only translated, never hidden), overlapping USPs on desktop and the hero card on mobile

Product cards: name/price chip was a tall white slab almost the same colour as the white image pad, with a big empty gap between name and price; the four layers did not read as separate plates when flat
Price typography was a tiny grey mono line, no energy for an athletic shop
Scores: creativity 7, typography 6.5, layout & rhythm 5 (empty sections), polish 4.5, brand robustness 7.5, mobile 4.5, generic-ness 6.5
fixed: Reveal now sweeps on IO, scroll and resize, revealing every .rv element at or above the viewport bottom, so fast scrolls and screenshots never leave sections hidden; transitions shortened (both pages)
Toast is hidden with opacity/visibility until an item is added (both pages)
Chip redesigned as a dark brand slab (--deep) with a primary tab mark, overlapping the lower edge of the image pad: image, chip and add button now visibly stack as separate layers even without tilt
Price set in Kanit 800 italic in a light primary tint; strike and 'on request' tuned for the dark chip; hero featured card keeps its light-card colours
